note: Main campground of Forestville/Mystery Cave State Park in the wooded South Branch Root River valley near Preston; trout fishing in the river and Canfield Creek, historic Forestville village and Mystery Cave tours nearby. Camper cabins and a separate horse camp. --Claude
summary: DNR + ReserveMN: 73 drive-in sites (23 electric, 30 A), all back-in, pads 31-70 ft, RV limit 50 ft; showers/flush (seasonal), vault toilets, dump; $25 / $35 electric re-read (2027). Season (manual) still matches the DNR and is left alone. Pin ~1 km north of the campground in forest: move. Not waterfront kept. River crossing near the camp closed after fall flooding.
flags: PIN: stored 43.6378,-92.2240 is in unbroken forest ~1 km north of the campground (ReserveMN unit centroid 43.63085,-92.22078; electric sites 71E-73E at ~43.6291,-92.2200). On imagery the camping loops lie around 43.6285-43.6300, -92.2195 to -92.2215. Recommend moving to 43.6291,-92.2208 (~970 m S).

Season (manual, 2026-10-20) not overwritten; it still agrees with the DNR ('Electric sites will be open from April 10 - October 18, 2026.'; 'Rustic non-electric campsites are available through November 30.'). It has no opens date: reviewer may add 04-10 (2026 electric opening) if wanted.
Fees: stored figures (ReserveMN 2026-10-12) re-read unchanged; written as manual, and the stored fees note is cleared (it repeated the rates and the state row's reservation fee and permit).
Not waterfront confirmed: ReserveMN gives sites '.1 mile' or more to the river; on imagery the South Branch Root River (~15-20 m wide, creek class) runs well north-east of the loops through woods.

Status: DNR alert 'the water crossing on the South Branch of the Root River near the main campground is closed' after fall flooding (trails open); shower building, flush toilets, water and the dump closed for the season; Mystery Cave closed until May 2027. Ordinary seasonal state.
